always.scope: Recorded model requests, including retries; excludes environment/startup. Unknown usage is not zero.

no_info.scope: Recorded model requests, including retries; excludes environment/startup. Unknown usage is not zero.

none.scope: Recorded model requests, including retries; excludes environment/startup. Unknown usage is not zero.

analysis_missing_definition: arm_outcomes.not_run counts games omitted because no complete shard attempt was selected; it does not assert those games were never executed. Raw attempt outcomes are retained below.

all_attempts_recorded_cost.scope: Recorded model requests, including retries; excludes environment/startup. Unknown usage is not zero.

all_attempts_runner_wall.scope: Sum of recorded runner walls across supplied attempts; excludes setup, teardown and queue. Missing phase times are unknown, not zero.

cost_limit: All supplied attempts retained, including incomplete/unselected attempts; uncertified or missing records make this a recorded lower bound, not total resource use.
confirmatory_rule: Only the primary 97.5% conservative paired interval decides direction; McNemar p is supplementary. Nonsignificance is not equivalence.
